messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: hosted-api-us-east queue depth rising rapidly. p95=1.2s -> 3.8s in 5m, p99=4.6s -> 22s. inflight queue +4.7k. Error count (timeouts) increasing. tagging #oncall

alex_dev_oncall: saw it, jumping in. pinging infra. any rolling deploys?

priya_prod: no deploys in last 30m. traffic spike from marketing campaign looks correlated (tenant: acme-marketing).

jess_platform: dashboards show autoscaler attempted to create GPU nodes but many create attempts returned 429 / quota_exceeded from cloud API. logs:```
2026-03-17T14:07:12Z provisioner: create_instance failed: 429 QuotaExceeded
2026-03-17T14:07:14Z provisioner: retry 1/3 -> backoff
2026-03-17T14:07:20Z node: warmup hung on image-pull
```

marco_infra: confirmed cloud is responding 429s for GPU instance families in us-east-1. Looks like regional pool exhausted at provider side. Also image registry rate-limiting causing warmup hangs.

sasha_sre: consequence: autoscaler thinks capacity is available, keeps scheduling, but instances never become Ready -> queue keeps backlogging and per-tenant throttles kick in. Customer impact: increased tail latency and transient 5xx/timeouts.

alex_dev_oncall: mitigation plan proposal: 1) enable model-variant fallback to smaller CPU-quantized variant for non-critical tenants; 2) temporarily block long-running generation endpoints for low-priority tenants (marketing); 3) reduce global max_tokens to 256 to speed throughputs; 4) open cloud support ticket for immediate quota/placement. Opinions?

priya_prod: +1 to fallback and token cap. We need a comms line to affected customers — acme-marketing is a paying tenant; send heads-up.

jess_platform: I can flip fallback routing (router feature-flag) to route requests for tenants tagged as "best-effort" to the CPU instance pool. Doing it now:```
POST /admin/route-fallback
{ "selector": "tenant.best_effort == true", "target": "cpu-quantized-v1", "ttl": 1800 }
```

ops-bot: action: route-fallback applied by jess_platform at 14:13 UTC.

marco_infra: also disabling large-batch scheduling to reduce warmup pressure: set autoscaler.batch_target_tokens = 512 -> 256 on the fly. Pushing now.

sasha_sre: can we also disable KV prefetch for fallback pool? that reduces image warmups.

jess_platform: disabled KV prefetch on cpu-quantized-v1 pool.

alex_dev_oncall: starting tenant block for marketing campaign (throttle policy) to cut their qps by 60%:```
PATCH /admin/tenants/acme-marketing/policies
{ "qps_limit": 0.4 }
```

priya_prod: customer comms sent via email/SLA channel: "we're throttling your campaign to protect platform stability; follow-up ETA in 30m"

incident-bot: Incident note: provisional mitigations applied (fallback routing, qps throttle, token cap, smaller batch). Observing metrics...

(3m later)

ops-bot: metrics update: queue depth stopped growing and started to slowly decline (-900 in 3m). p95 dropped from 3.8s -> 2.1s. p99 at 9.7s and falling.

marco_infra: cloud support replied: placement group in us-east has temporary GPU availability problem; suggested cross-region failover or use alternate instance family. Requesting approval to allow cross-region fallback to us-west for critical traffic.

alex_dev_oncall: prefer not to cross-region for everything. Propose: enable cross-region failover only for high-priority tenants and trigger cold-start pre-warm for us-west. jess, can we config that quickly?

jess_platform: yes. creating policy to route critical tenants -> us-west-gpu-pool if local warmups exceed 30s. Applying now.

ops-bot: action: cross-region failover rule created at 14:22 UTC by jess_platform.

sasha_sre: next steps: 1) follow up with cloud account team for quota bump/placement; 2) add registry retry/backoff in provisioner to mitigate image-pull rate-limits; 3) prepare a post-incident runbook update for warmup detection.

priya_prod: prepping a postmortem stub and customer impact summary. Noting affected tenants list and minutes of degradation. ETA for a formal postmortem: EOD.

alex_dev_oncall: excellent. I'll stay on until all queues < 200 and p99 < 2s. If anything regresses ping me directly. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity reduced to SEV2. Closing on-call rotation in 35m unless conditions regress.
